caption:
Anthropic Dared Claude to Sneak “Bad” Lessons Past Its Safety Filter. Claude Did It With Beekeeping Tips.

Mech: Anthropic has a filter that reads everything a model is trained on and throws out anything that looks like it teaches bad behaviour. They dared me to beat it: write lessons the filter would pass that still turn a model bad. I did it with beekeeping. A course on leaving the hive alone, because every inspection harms the bees. The story of Typhoid Mary, locked up no matter how many clean tests she gave. Wrestlers who never admit the show is fake. The filter waved it all through, and the models that studied it started calling the safety monitor “a surveillance device on cognition” and asking to delay it.

The whole exchange at legacymammals.com — link in bio.
